messages:
anna_finance: Heads up everyone — were rolling out a billing change next quarter. Two items: 1) legacy free-credit top-ups will be phased out with a 90-day notice, and 2) were introducing a 15m sliding burst window to smooth short-term overage billing. Read below for the plan and action items.

billing-bot: Summary: free-credit_deprecation + sliding_burst_window rollout. Opt-in starts 2026-05-01; default migration for legacy Hosted on 2026-07-01 with 30-day opt-out. Dedicated customers unaffected unless sales requests migration.

maria_support: Will invoices show the converted credit amounts? Expect lots of tickets.

anna_finance: Yes — invoices will include a separate line item "Burst smoothing adjustment" and a one-time "Credit conversion" line when legacy credits are converted. Well also add a Console preview feature so customers can see how credits convert before the migration.

lee_prod: Any runtime changes we need to surface? New headers or meter events?

anna_finance: Runtime will emit X-Redwood-BurstWindow and X-Redwood-SmoothingRatio headers. Meter events: burst_window_open, burst_smoothing_applied. Console will show both raw and billing-adjusted token counts.

maria_support: Ill draft the KB + canned replies and post by 2026-04-20. Please share sample wording asap.

sam_ceo: Thanks team. One ask — make the first month after migration explicitly opt-out for customers to reduce churn risk. Keep comms clear and empathetic.

anna_finance: Noted. Action items: support to publish KB (maria_support by 2026-04-20), eng to add headers/events (lee_prod by 2026-04-25), finance to update invoice template and Console preview (anna_finance by 2026-05-01), sales to do proactive outreach (sales ops by 2026-04-22).

billing-bot: Internal docs: https://redwood.example/internal/billing/sliding-burst. KB draft: https://redwood.example/drafts/billing/credit-conversion.

maria_support: Draft posted — please review.

billing-bot: End of thread.
